item.title: Independent Candidates Seek Middle Ground with Voters
item.description: Nearly 200 independent candidates in over 100 congressional races aim to offer an alternative to the two-party system.

item.title: Ice Cream and the Nobel Prize in Economics
item.description: Sticky prices help explain why recessions are severe and what policymakers can do about them.

item.title: Restoring seabirds may help protect coral reefs
item.description: Coral reefs face growing threats worldwide. On a remote Pacific island, scientists found that reefs can benefit from an unexpected source.

item.title: Polls are a snapshot: what to remember during midterm elections
item.description: With Election Day approaching and millions of votes already cast, midterm polls are widespread. Polling can be a useful tool for understanding.
